Subject: Escalation: Aperture Health — request for >20% hosted API concession (summary + recommended path)

Team —

Escalating Aperture Health (HS-45821). Rep: Ben Carter. External contact: Laura Chen. They project ~1B tokens/month within 6 months if run rate holds. Customer requests a 30% concession on hosted-API usage for a 12-month committed term. Finance has modelled that any concession beyond 20% materially impacts unit economics unless we secure up-front consideration.

Summary / recommendation:
- Recommended approved concession: 25% off list hosted API usage for 12 months conditional on a 6-month prepay or a 20% prepayment + monthly minimums.
- Alternative (less-risk): 22% off with 3-month prepay and 30-day ramp break-clauses.
- Required: SRE review of latency/SLOs (no private deployment requested), SOC2 + standard DPA fine.
- Risk: If we provide 30% without prepay or surge caps, projected marginal cost could turn negative under the projected usage curve.

Attachments: Aperture_deal_summary.pdf (includes expected token profile and margin sensitivity).

Ask: Need exec sign-off for any concession >20% (Rishi or Karthik). Please advise by COB Monday 13 Nov — customer is pushing for a term sheet by next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Deal Operations
Redwood Inference

Forwarding Marissa’s summary — financials attached. My read: customer is strategic (healthcare, regional footprint) and could be a reference for our hosted API reliability/cost story. I support a conditional concession (see recommended 25% with prepay + surge cap).

If you’re comfortable we can offer 25% for a 12-month committed term with 20% prepayment + 120% surge cap (i.e., after committed volume, additional usage billed at list). If exec isn’t comfortable, fallback to 22% with a 3-month prepay.

Please sign off so we can get a term sheet to Aperture — they’ve requested a commercial redline by next Thursday.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Escalation: Aperture Health — approval requested (>20% concession)

Thanks for the clear summary. I approve a 25% concession on hosted-API usage rates for Aperture Health for a 12-month committed term under the following mandatory conditions:
1) Customer prepays 20% of the 12-month committed spend within 7 business days of signature.
2) We include a surge cap: any usage above 120% of committed monthly volume billed at list price.
3) Standard DPA and SOC2 attestation on file (Ops to confirm).
4) Finance will require monthly usage reporting and a 30-day review clause at month 3 to reassess economics.

If the customer cannot meet condition (1), approve fallback: 22% concession with a 3-month prepay.

Please proceed to draft the term sheet and get DocuSign initiated. Copy me on the signed term sheet.

Rishi Malhotra
